name: roundtable
description: Ask a council of AI models (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok, GLM, MiniMax) one question and get one decision back. Includes the roundtable command, a skill, and an MCP tool. Nothing else to install.

anthropic_api_key.title: Anthropic API key (optional)
anthropic_api_key.description: Adds the Claude head and the chair that calls consensus. Leave blank to skip.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key (optional)
openai_api_key.description: Adds the OpenAI head. Leave blank to skip.

gemini_api_key.title: Gemini API key (optional)
gemini_api_key.description: Adds the Gemini head. Leave blank to skip.

xai_api_key.title: xAI API key (optional)
xai_api_key.description: Adds the Grok head. Leave blank to skip.
